campaign.goal: Route a selected Compiler session's native application build request through its typed Environment capability.

coordination.reason: Adopt the isolated campaign checkout containing only its Environment definition, then implement the scoped authorization repair.
coordination.prior_state: Environment claim inventory showed no live Control main-checkout lease; other active Compiler and Environment work remained on separate checkouts.

observed_failure.message: Compiler application build requires one selected Environment session and a relative JSON request path

follow_up_observation.cause: The original shared artifact-path validator rejected dot-prefixed path segments, including the project's ignored .build directory.

repair.policy: The existing bounded native-application build contract may use either the selected Environment project grant or the selected Compiler project grant. Its request path accepts safe dot-prefixed segments such as .build while rejecting dot, dot-dot, empty, absolute, and parent-traversal segments.
retained_checks: grant-bound session identity equals requested Environment session
all other capabilities retain their existing project boundary

validation.full_suite: not run; validation remained bounded to the affected Environment RPC paths
